text:
For a **fridge, CPAP, and other essentials through an overnight outage**, I’d get the **[BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W solar panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit)**. It has a 2,073.6 Wh battery and can take up to 1,000 W of solar input if you add panels later. The listing shows it at $1,199 before any current discounts. ([Kit details and pricing](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-for-hurricane-season))

It’s a portable backup, **not a whole-home solution**. Charge it before a storm, and check that its output and battery capacity suit the specific appliances you need to run. If your priority is simply spending less, the same comparison lists a **[BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit)** at $729, but I’d favor the larger Elite for a multi-day outage plan.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
